name: 404 & Redirects Fixer For SEO Pass
author: MD. THOUHIDUL ISLAM

sections.description:
404 & Redirects Fixer For SEO Pass is an advanced, secure plugin designed to manage your website’s redirections easily and protect your SEO rankings with comprehensive 404 error tracking.

  • 404 Error Tracker: Find exactly which broken links visitors are hitting, along with referrer tracking.
  • One-Click Redirect: Instantly turn any 404 error log into a working redirect with a single button click.
  • CSV Import/Export: Seamlessly migrate rules from Rank Math, Yoast, or Redirection, and export your setup for backup.
  • Bulk Management: Easily search through hundreds of links and use bulk-delete features to keep things clean.
  • Hit Counter: Track traffic for each redirect, complete with a reset button.
  • Smart URL Formatting: Automatically strips the domain name if you accidentally paste a full URL into the source field.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. A new tabbed menu “Redirect Manager” will appear where you can access rules, logs, and tools.
sections.changelog:
2.0

  • New: Added 404 Error Log Tracker.
  • New: One-Click Quick Redirect from the 404 log table.
  • New: Added CSV Import and Export features for easy migration.
  • New: Search filter and Bulk Delete actions.
  • New: Hit Counter Reset button.
  • New: Automatic Source URL formatting (domain stripping).
  • Tweak: Organized the admin dashboard into clean, user-friendly tabs.

1.0

  • Initial release on WordPress.org.
